name: pro.publifye/brreg
title: Brreg
description: Norway's company register (Enhetsregisteret) for AI: lookup, search, name resolution, key financials

tools.name: code_list
tools.description: Filter-value discovery with counts from the current snapshot: list org_form, municipality, nace or sector; optional query matches a code prefix or description text. Use the codes as entity_search filt

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: Exact lookup by organisasjonsnummer in Enhetsregisteret; never fuzzy. Pass orgnr (one) or orgnrs (several, results in input order); spaces and dots are tolerated. Each item is {orgnr, found, record?,

tools.name: entity_resolve
tools.description: Name to organisation candidates, never an implicit pick. Compares with one documented key: NFC, lowercase, fold æ→ae ø→o å→a (oe and aa spellings also match), & → og, punctuation stripped, trailing le

tools.name: entity_search
tools.description: Ranked, filtered search over current and historical names, addresses and websites. Give at least one of query, address, website or a filter. Filters: kind, org_form (codes from code_list), municipalit

tools.name: entity_structure
tools.description: Organisational structure of one orgnr as a stream of items with relation parent (overordnet chain to the root, depth 1 = direct parent, at most 20), child (enheter whose parent is this orgnr) and subu

tools.name: snapshot_status
tools.description: Snapshot readiness and provenance: snapshot_id, acquired_at, age and stale flag, source ETag and Last-Modified per dataset, record counts (enheter, underenheter, enk, public_bodies, deleted), build an
